name: Baserow
description: Create your own online database without technical experience. Our user-friendly no-code tool gives you the powers of a developer without leaving your browser.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-baserow application
services:
  # Service name: app
  app:
    # Set the name of the Docker container.
    container_name: baserow
    # Use the specified Docker image for Baserow and specify its version.
    image: baserow/baserow:2.4.1@sha256:2229bc0ad9c8e1c3c44cef3324ff0501639d44a7b6f64026ebaa44f61cfb038e
    # Set environment variables for Baserow.
    environment:
      # Set the your CASA OS IP for Baserow to use.
      BASEROW_PUBLIC_URL: "http://[YOUR_CASAOS_IP]:7350"
    # Map ports from the host machine to the Baserow container.
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:80" # Map port 7300 on the host to port 80 in the container.
      - "7351:443" # Map port 7301 on the host to port 443 in the container.
    # Define volumes to persist data between container restarts.
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/baserow/data
